name: Mailbox size, quotas and archive (toolkit run)
description: Reads every mailbox's size, warning and send quotas and, optionally, its archive, through the toolkit's own read-only runner. Each value says whether it was read; nothing unread is shown as zero.

parameters.name: IncludeArchive
parameters.label: Include archives
parameters.help: Also read whether each mailbox has an archive and, when it does, the archive's size and quota. One extra read per archive.

prerequisites: ExchangeOnlineManagement 3.7.0 or later installed through your organisation's approved process, and an Exchange role that can read mailboxes and their statistics. The toolkit does not install modules or change policy.
limitations: Runs only through the toolkit's read-only runner; it has no Copy form. Desktop Run requires experimental read-only opt-in for the current verified connection and separate approval of each exact review.
One statistics read per mailbox, and one more per archive: a large tenant may reach the 30-minute limit, and rows read by then are kept only as partial.
An archive is counted as present only when Exchange returns a non-empty archive GUID. Recoverable Items, OST and PST sizes are not reported.
Live behaviour, the roles required and the module's output format are unverified until accepted in a test tenant.
